CustomField.formula:
CASE(MONTH( Date__c ), 1, "[01-"+TEXT( YEAR(Date__c ))+"]. JAN", 2, "[02-"+TEXT( YEAR(Date__c ))+"]. FEB", 3, "[03-"+TEXT( YEAR(Date__c ))+"]. MAR", 4, "[04-"+TEXT( YEAR(Date__c ))+"]. APR", 5, "[05-"+TEXT( YEAR(Date__c ))+"]. MAY", 6, "[06-"+TEXT( YEAR(Date__c ))+"]. JUN", 7, "[07-"+TEXT( YEAR(Date__c ))+"]. JUL", 8, "[08-"+TEXT( YEAR(Date__c ))+"]. AUG", 9, "[09-"+TEXT( YEAR(Date__c ))+"]. SEP", 10, "[10-"+TEXT( YEAR(Date__c ))+"]. OCT", 11, "[11-"+TEXT( YEAR(Date__c ))+"]. NOV", 12, "[12-"+TEXT( YEAR(Date__c ))+"]. DEC", "None")
+ " " + TEXT( YEAR(Date__c ) )
CustomField.label: Month
